question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

15, 16, 20, 29, 45, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Squares of a consecutive series is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e650235ecc2f894b39a8ee7909500db577246d23d6fa40ec333f4b1a583edc14.png]
